title: Reddit: 95% AI-Written Code Discussion
description: Reddit r/programming discussion about AI code generation capabilities and implications for software development. Community perspectives on the shift toward AI-authored code.
author: Reddit Community

title: Reddit: AI Developer Tools Landscape 2026
description: Reddit r/LLMDevs discussion about best AI tools, digital tools, and automation platforms for developers in 2026. Community sharing insights on the evolving AI development tooling ecosystem.
author: Reddit Community

title: Simon Willison: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Limited Preview Announcement
description: Simon Willison discusses OpenAI's limited preview of GPT-5.6 series (Sol, Terra, Luna models) starting with a small group of trusted partners before broader release. Notable features include Sol at $5 input/$30 output per million tokens, Terra with competitive performance to GPT-5.5 at 2x cheaper, and Luna at lowest cost. Includes improved prompt caching with explicit cache breakpoints and 30-minute minimum cache life.
author: Simon Willison

title: Replit's Vision: 1 Billion Developers Worldwide
description: Amjad Masad, CEO of Replit, articulates a vision of democratizing software development to reach 1 billion developers globally. Discusses how AI-powered coding platforms are lowering barriers to entry and transforming the economy.
author: Amjad Masad

title: Simon Willison: AI and Liability - German Google Ruling
description: Simon Willison shares Bruce Schneier's analysis of a German ruling that Google be held liable for errors in AI overviews. The key insight: AI agents are agents of the person or organization that deploys them and should be treated as such by law. Allowing businesses to hide behind faulty AI excuses would create disastrous incentives and undermine accountability.
author: Simon Willison

title: Claude Code: The First Convincing LLM Agent Demonstration
description: Andrej Karpathy discusses Claude Code as 'the first convincing demonstration of what an LLM Agent looks like,' highlighting how it represents a significant milestone in AI agent capabilities and coding workflows.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: State of AI in 2026: LLMs, Coding, Scaling Laws
description: Lex Fridman Podcast episode #416 covering recent developments in AI, including open & closed AI models, LLMs for coding, scaling laws, and AI developments in China. Provides comprehensive overview of AI landscape in 2026.
author: Lex Fridman

title: Simon Willison: Browser Compatibility Database with Claude Code
description: Simon Willison converts Mozilla's MDN browser-compat-data repository into a SQLite database using Claude Code. The project demonstrates AI-assisted programming workflows, with GPT-5.5 building GitHub Actions workflows for database generation and CDN hosting.
author: Simon Willison

title: Using LLMs as Knowledge Compilers, Not Just Code Generators
description: Analysis of Karpathy's evolving approach to LLMs - shifting from treating them as code generation tools to using them as 'knowledge compilers' that help developers think through problems. The 'vibe coding' concept emphasizes AI as a thinking partner.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Simon Willison: Porting Moebius 0.2B Image Inpainting to Browser with Claude Code
description: Simon Willison successfully ports the Moebius 0.2B image inpainting model to run in the browser using WebGPU, transforming it from PyTorch/CUDA requirement to browser-based demo. The project demonstrates Claude Code's capabilities for helping port ML models to web environments, showcasing practical AI-assisted development workflows.
author: Simon Willison

title: Simon Willison: Prompt Injection as Role Confusion Research
description: Simon Willison analyzes research on 'role confusion' in LLMs - the challenge of having models distinguish their own privileged text (in system tags) from untrusted user input. The research shows models take writing style more seriously than actual content, leading to concerning jailbreaks. 'Destyling' text can reduce attack success from 61% to 10%.
author: Simon Willison

title: Top 10 AI Coding Models Ranked: GPT-5.5 vs Claude Opus 4.8
description: Detailed comparison of top AI coding models including GPT-5.5, 5.4, Claude Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6, Qwen 3.6. Analysis covers coding capabilities, reasoning, and real-world performance metrics.
author: Build MVP Fast

title: Simon Willison: Cloudflare Temporary Accounts for AI Agents
description: Simon Willison explores Cloudflare's new temporary deployment feature for AI agents - allowing deployment without account creation for 60-minute ephemeral projects. He demonstrates this by having GPT-5.5 build a test application for following HTTP redirects, noting the feature is useful beyond just AI agents.
author: Simon Willison

title: Hacker News: AI Coding Negativity Discussion
description: Hacker News discussion titled 'I read AI coding negativity on Hacker News and Reddit with more astonishment' - addresses perceptions about LLM agent performance and the reality of AI coding capabilities.
author: Hacker News Community
